FNAF 2 REVAMP COMING SOON! STAY TUNED!

Be the animatronic!

📜 A multiplayer strategy-horror game based on the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise, where you can play as the animatronic or night guard with or against your friends.

⚠️ This game contains loud noises, flashing lights, jumpscares, and more.
❓ To become an animatronic, all players are given FNAF 1 Freddy for free, or purchase one in the item shop with Remnant gained from playing matches or doing tasks as a night guard!
📝 Inspired by Scott Cawthon's Five Nights at Freddy's series and franchise!
